QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Darkness Draws Near
QuestInfo.0: Ellin in the #m300030100# has a serious look about her. That probably means she has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: There are fairies here who are conspiring with the Black Mage. I think they're planning something terrible for all of Victoria Island. I need you to get this news to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.2: You told Athena Pierce about Ellin's discovery. She looks utterly shocked, and for good reason.

0.0: Look, I can't deal with this myself. Tell Athena Pierce! Her people are in just as much danger!

yes.0: Not too long ago, I saw a minion of the Black Mage here in the Fairy Forest. I knew the fairies had been acting weird lately, but I had no idea...
yes.1: Anyways, I followed that minion and overheard that Lady Ephenia has joined forces with the Black Mage! She's planning to contaminate Victoria Island with poison, and eradicate all life here. Athena Pierce needs to know about this...and she needs to stop Lady Ephenia.

no.0: This is very very important. Talk to me again when your heart is ready.

1.0: Ah, welcome. Thank you for helping us look for a new settlement earlier. But what brings you here this time? You don't look so well...
1.1: You have something that you must tell me?

yes.0: No...that's...impossible... She's the queen of fairies... How could she agree to such a thing?!

npc.0: Give Athena Pierce this news NOW! We don't have a second to lose!
